title: E.ON - Wikipedia
content: # E.ON. | E.ON's corporate headquarters in Essen, Germany | |. | Subsidiaries | E.ON Ruhrgas E.ON UK E.ON Sverige |. **E.ON SE** is a German multinational electric utility company based in Essen, Germany. The company is a component of the DAX stock index. E.ON was created in 2000 through the merger of VEBA and VIAG. In 2016, it separated its conventional power generation and energy trading operations into a new company, Uniper, while retaining retail, distribution and nuclear operations. E.ON sold its stake in Uniper through a stock market listing and sold the remaining stock to the Finnish utility Fortum. In March 2018, it was announced that E.ON would acquire the utility portion of renewable energy utility Innogy through a complex €43 billion asset swap deal between E.ON, Innogy and RWE. In 2020, E.ON UK announced that it would be migrating customers over to a new subsidiary brand called E.ON Next.
